dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The sea around here is dangerous...

dialogues.speaker: Tuokko
dialogues.text: I know that, but I also know my old partner's got what it takes to pull through. Her cooling system might be on the brink, but we're in Nod-Krai, it's not exactly Natlan out here!

dialogues.speaker: Tuokko
dialogues.text: *sigh* It's all my fault — I never knuckled down when I was younger. Now I'm old, I'm realizing that time waits for no man. No matter what, I'm determined to give my daughter a proper start.
